# Installing seabORD

This vignette explains how to install the development version of **seabORD** directly from GitHub.

*must have: RStudio with up to date R*

## Prerequisites

To install packages from GitHub, you will need the **remotes** package:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("remotes")
```

## Installing seabORD

Install the latest development version from GitHub with:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
remotes::install_github("NERC-CEH/seabORD_pkg") 
```

## Load the package

Once installation is complete, load the package:

```{r, ,warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(seabORD)
```

## Updating seabORD

To update to the latest development version, rerun:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
remotes::install_github("NERC-CEH/seabORD_pkg")
```

## Next steps

Follow the tutorial and examples and start playing with seabORD!
